note: Hand-written object -> model choices of tools/genSAEntityKeys.py (read by it). The object list's names are the game's own; which INI model an object draws is a hypothesis from the names unless a note says it was read from the machine code. A model is the INI's model name of its module.

noModel.note: Objects that only spawn or remove other things at run time (hypothesis, from the names; their code names the Orca or the fish models without drawing them): no model, so they get a marker. O DOLSW: 'dolphin switch' (hypothesis, from the name): its code names the Dolphin model because it starts the jumping dolphin; the switch itself shows nothing. O MKUSA: the only model its code names is Parasol A, which cannot be a grass. O BEWIND: observed (user): its first guessed model, 'Floating Pier', showed up as a piece of a bridge where nothing is; that model belongs to the floating bridge the stage's own code creates (the level file's source.added, docs/EMERALD_COAST_OBJECTS.md), whose code sits in the same source file as BEWIND's (_Stg01.rel 0x16F0C to 0x1883C). BEWIND's own exec (0x16F0C, 104 bytes) checks the players, clamps its scale components and draws a debug volume only; its two records are high above the ground with scale (111, 0, 230) (hypothesis: an invisible volume).

stageModels.note: Stage objects whose model is named by hand, by the INI's model name of the stage module (hypothesis, from the names). O PARASOL: external, the decompile of _Stg01.rel (FUN_8040e364): the byte of the record's scale x modulo 5 picks one of 5 parasol kinds (its debug text is 'KIND OF PARASOL'). O PIER: its guessed model, 'Pier Collision', is a white collision plane and 'Floating Pier' belongs to O BEWIND's chain (observed, user); the pier's own models are the variant models' (the straight pier is the first). O BED and O KASA: display code seen in a RAM dump of Emerald Coast act 1 (machine code): O BED draws 'Beach Bed' (_Stg01.rel 0x41C4), O KASA draws 'Straw Umbrella' (0xB0B8).

mainModels.note: Shared objects' models by the INI's model name of _Main.rel (hypothesis from the names). SPRINGB: the INI's 'Rotatable Spring' is object/bane_type_b (type B) and the records turn it about all three axes (hypothesis: the name); 'Triple Spring' is bane_yoko_body, a side spring.
